left.title: I Am Part of the Resistance Inside the Trump Administration
left.body: I work for the president but like-minded colleagues and I have vowed to thwart parts of his agenda and his worst inclinations.
left.roundup: A senior official in the Trump administration wrote an anonymous op-ed published in The New York Times on Wednesday, saying they are working to "thwart" parts of the president's agenda as well as his "worst inclinations."

center.title: Senior administration official blasts Trump in anonymous NYT op-ed
center.body: A person identified as a senior administration official blasted President Trump in an anonymous op-ed published by The New York Times on Wednesday, saying they were working to “thwart” President Trump’s “worst inclinations.”
center.roundup: A senior official in the Trump administration wrote an anonymous op-ed published in The New York Times on Wednesday, saying they are working to "thwart" parts of the president's agenda as well as his "worst inclinations."

right.title: Anonymous Official in NYT Op-Ed: I’m Working to Control Trump’s ‘Worst Inclinations’
right.body: In an unsigned op-ed published in the New York Times Wednesday, a high-ranking administration official described working with other members of the so-called “steady state” to rein in the president’s “worst inclinations.”
right.roundup: A senior official in the Trump administration wrote an anonymous op-ed published in The New York Times on Wednesday, saying they are working to "thwart" parts of the president's agenda as well as his "worst inclinations."
